messages:
Samira Patel: t-minus 30 to ramp runtime v3.5 in eu-west1. plan to shift 1% -> 10% over 20m, then full if metrics hold. pinging owners for quick ack list below, will flip if no objections by t-5.

Samira Patel: checklist (quick):
```
- [ ] infra health (Ben)
- [ ] smoke suite pass (Maya)
- [ ] rollback artifacts present (Leo)
- [ ] alerting + paging enabled (sre-oncall)
- [ ] canary routing policy set to 1%
- [ ] post-deploy perf baseline captured
```

Ben K: infra health: nodes ok, autoscaler steady. did a config diff against last deploy, nothing unexpected. marking infra green now. :white_check_mark:

Maya R: starting smoke run now (quick-ops smoke, 12 tests). I’ll post failures if any in the next 4m. current: 8/12 passed, retrying flakier ones.

Leo: rollback artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-rollbacks/runtime/v3.5 and playbook linked in runbook. Permissions verified for the oncall group.

sre-oncall: I’ve enabled paging for request_latency and error_budget burn > 2%/5m. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/d/ops/runtime-v3-5. Alerts set to critical -> page.

ops-bot: Deploy window reserved: 14:05–14:35 UTC. Canary route created: route-id r-2026-09-01-1pct.

Maya R: smoke suite finished: 12/12 pass. no regressions on token generation or auth. logs look clean. :thumbsup:

Ben K: infra stays green after smoke. no infra-level alarms.

Samira Patel: quick final: if everyone is :thumbsup: we’ll move to 1% now, then monitor 10m and ramp. please react or reply if any objection.

Leo: :thumbsup: from me. Rollback ready.

sre-oncall: :thumbsup: monitoring live, will page if SLOs degrade.

Maya R: :thumbsup: smoke ok.

Ben K: :thumbsup:

Samira Patel: GO — flipping canary to 1% at 14:05 UTC. will update thread at 14:15 with metrics snapshot. :rocket:

ops-bot: Canary change applied at 14:05:12 UTC. route r-2026-09-01-1pct -> 1%.

Samira Patel: 14:15 update: latency +0.4ms p50, error rate steady at baseline. continuing ramp to 10% at t+20.

sre-oncall: noted. no pages. continuing to watch dashboards.

Samira Patel: closing this thread after full ramp. final note: rollback plan is owner-assigned to Leo for 30m post-ramp. thanks all. :tada:
